text:
The git-strategy proposal is clear, so I made no rewrite. `text-check.mjs` flagged nothing, and the title and short numbered sections read quickly. The owner's asks are quoted in their own words.

I appended one "clear" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. I didn't open any page screenshots, because the target is only a `requirements.md` for agents, with no `page.js`.
